14"""Launch-scoped control of the ``TRITONXPU_BF16_FAST`` store lowering. 

15 

16Why this exists 

17--------------- 

18The XPU backend has two lowerings for an ``f32 -> bf16`` store 

19(``TritonXPUToLLVM/LoadStoreOpToLLVM.cpp``): 

20 

21* **default** -- per-lane ``vand``/``vadd`` rounding chain, then two masked 

22 ``SCATTER_MH`` ops. Costs ~+150us at n = 16.7M (a ~1.35x slowdown of the 

23 whole op versus the equivalent f32 store). 

24* **fast** (``TRITONXPU_BF16_FAST=1``) -- the vendor ``vstore2_lm`` device 

25 call: one hardware-rounded 16->bf16 pack + store per two 512-bit vectors, 

26 ~70us faster at 16.7M. Same lowering the vendor's own sglang kernels use 

27 (see ``third_party/xpu/test/sglang/qwen3_next/test_l2norm_fwd_kernel.py``). 

28 

29The two lowerings are **not** bit-identical, contrary to what the comment this 

30helper replaces used to claim. They differ in the RNE tie bias: the fast path 

31biases on mantissa bit 16 (``0x7FFF + ((x >> 16) & 1)``, textbook round-half-to- 

32even), while the default path biases on bit 0. They therefore disagree only 

33when the discarded low half is exactly ``0x8000`` -- but that is enough to move 

34a bf16 result by one ULP, which is observable against a tight tolerance (this 

35is how ``adaptive_avg_pool2d_backward`` at ``atol=1e-4`` flipped from pass to 

36fail once the flag was switched on globally). 

37 

38Why it is scoped, not global 

39---------------------------- 

40This flag is read once, when the kernel is compiled, and it is listed in 

41``CACHE_INVALIDATING_ENV_VARS`` (``include/triton/Tools/Sys/GetEnv.hpp``), so it 

42is part of the JIT cache key. A module-level ``os.environ.setdefault`` in one 

43op therefore (a) changes the bf16 numerics of *every other op* in the process 

44and (b) cannot be undone by a caller who did not set it. Entering this scope 

45around a single launch keeps the benefit where it has been measured, and leaves 

46every other op on the default lowering. 

47 

48The scope is only entered for bf16 outputs: the flag changes nothing else, and 

49entering it unconditionally would fork the cache key (and so force a second 

50compilation) for fp16/fp32 kernels whose generated code is identical. 

51""" 

52 

53import contextlib 

54import os 

55 

56import torch 

57 

58_ENV_KEY = "TRITONXPU_BF16_FAST" 

59 

60 

61@contextlib.contextmanager 

62def bf16_fast_store(out_dtype): 

63 """Select the fast f32->bf16 store lowering for the enclosed launch. 

64 

65 No-op unless ``out_dtype`` is ``torch.bfloat16``. **A caller's explicit 

66 setting always wins**: if the variable is already present (``"0"`` to opt 

67 out, ``"1"`` to force it on), this block does not touch it. Otherwise the 

68 variable is set to ``"1"`` for the duration of the block and removed on 

69 exit, so nothing leaks past the launch. 

70 """ 

71 if out_dtype is not torch.bfloat16: 

72 yield 

73 return 

74 if os.environ.get(_ENV_KEY) is not None: 

75 # Explicit caller setting wins -- do not override it. 

76 yield 

77 return 

78 os.environ[_ENV_KEY] = "1" 

79 try: 

80 yield 

81 finally: 

82 os.environ.pop(_ENV_KEY, None)
